baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired constructions الحمد لله and له ما...وله الحمد join praise to possession across السماوات, الأرض, and الآخرة.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated praise is allocated to God because every occupant of the upper and lower domains is his, and the later domain extends that attribution beyond the present order. Spatial totality and temporal succession make the opening a comprehensive attribution rather than an isolated formula.

activation_trace.role: Praise opposed to blame and responsive to beneficence supplies the evaluative act that the repetition extends across both clauses.
The worshipped one supplies the sole recipient to whom the lām construction allocates praise.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper domain of the ownership claim.
The lower realm opposite the sky completes the spatial totality governed by له ما.
What comes after the first order supplies the temporal extension in which praise still belongs to God.

changed_reading.before: A conventional opening that praises God and then mentions his cosmic ownership.
changed_reading.after: A total attribution: because every upper and lower domain is his, praise belongs to him across both the present order and what follows it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing وهو الحكيم الخبير qualifies the owner praised in the two preceding له constructions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wisdom as right-judging restraint and expertise as knowledge of an affair's interior turn possession into informed governance. The final pair warrants praise by denying that universal ownership is blind force or arbitrary control.

activation_trace.role: Restraint that prevents corruption and restores order supplies the corrective function of divine governance.
Knowledge that reaches the right judgment supplies the precision rather than arbitrariness of that restraint.
Knowledge gained through the inward reality of an affair supplies the penetrative awareness paired with wisdom.

changed_reading.before: الحكيم الخبير are general laudatory epithets appended to the doxology.
changed_reading.after: They specify why total dominion is praiseworthy: it is corrective, rightly judged, and informed by the interior of every matter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation وله الحمد في الآخرة places the second الحمد specifically inside the later domain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch image of حمد as a praiseworthy limit and the laterness of الآخرة allow praise to function not only as an utterance made later but as the commendable terminus reached when the order is completed.

activation_trace.role: The praiseworthy utmost limit supplies a telic image for the repeated الحمد.
Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon at which that praiseworthy limit is reached.
Bringing something to an exact and finished state supplies the completion mechanism behind the end-state reading.

changed_reading.before: Praise is simply repeated in the hereafter.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the later order is also the point at which governance reaches a praiseworthy completed state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first context turns the cosmic pair into a circulation system: things enter and leave the earth, descend from and ascend into the sky, yet neither a remote nor particle-sized item escapes disclosure and registration. له ما therefore reads as continuously informed custody, not inert possession.

activation_trace.role: Interior knowledge anchors the focus claim that all cross-domain movement remains experientially known.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the overseeing awareness around the four movements.
Entry into another interior supplies the inward leg of the earth-side circulation.
Passage to the outside supplies the outward leg paired with entry.
Descent and arrival supply the downward leg from the sky.
Ascent upward supplies the return leg into the sky.
Distance, absence, and escape supply the failure condition explicitly denied of divine knowledge.
Minute particles and their dispersal supply the smallest scale still held within custody.
An inscription that establishes an obligatory determination supplies the accounting endpoint of the monitored circulation.

structural_cues: 34:2 arranges four opposed directional processes around a single verb of knowing.
34:3 moves from denied absence through particle scale to inclusion in a clarifying record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulation, non-escape, minuteness, and determinative inscription; I supply the arrow from those details to active custody under له ما. A live alternative is that the sequence illustrates omniscience only as a premise for resurrection and recompense.

changed_reading.before: God possesses everything located in two cosmic regions.
changed_reading.after: Everything is his while moving across those regions, down to dispersed particles, because no transition exits his knowledge or accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's sequence moves from returning response by mountains and birds to softened iron, proportioned links, deliberate work, and gratitude. It activates الحمد as a distributed response enacted acoustically, materially, and ethically by an owned world made capable of answering well.

activation_trace.role: Praise and thanks for beneficence anchor the focus response that the craft sequence distributes into creation.
Repeated bodily return supplies the responsive rhythm assigned to mountains alongside David.
Light flight and birds extend the returning response from fixed mountains into mobile creatures.
Softness opposed to roughness makes resistant material responsive to direction.
Iron's hard resistance supplies the material force transformed into workable response.
Fitting a thing to its proper measure supplies the proportional discipline of the links.
Piercing and joining rings or hide supplies the connective craft by which measured parts become protection.
Intentional action turns responsive material into accountable workmanship.
Recognition of beneficence and praise of the giver names the ethical completion of the work sequence.

structural_cues: 34:10-13 progresses from responsive sound, through material softening and measured joining, to the command to work as gratitude.
Fixed mountains, flying creatures, metal, artisans, and a household occupy distinct scales but share a response pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, softened resistance, proportioned joining, work, and gratitude; I infer that their shared arrow is creation answering beneficence in ordered forms. Alternatively, these are separate gifts whose only direct link to 34:1 is that gifts merit praise.

changed_reading.before: الحمد is principally a verbal declaration about the owner of creation.
changed_reading.after: الحمد also becomes a world-response: creation returns, yields, takes measure, joins, works, and gives thanks under wise ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence tests whether owned abundance is received as provision and returned as gratitude. Turning away converts a contained water system into a destructive flood, substitutes bitter yield for good land, and ends in social-spatial fragmentation. Praise is thus the relational practice that keeps gift recognizable as gift rather than self-owned infrastructure.

activation_trace.role: Praise joined to thanks for beneficence anchors the response whose refusal the Saba sequence tests.
An apportioned gift supplies the status of the garden produce before it is treated as autonomous possession.
Recognizing the blessing and praising its giver supplies the requested return of the apportioned gift.
Turning one's side away supplies the relational break between provision and grateful return.
The embankment that confines floodwater supplies the infrastructure whose reversal releases destructive flow.
One thing taking another's place supplies the conversion of flourishing gardens into diminished yield.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the final social and spatial form of the broken gift relation.

structural_cues: 34:15 pairs edible provision with an imperative of gratitude.
34:16 reverses water control and produce; 34:18-19 reverses connected secure routes into requested distance and total dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, requested gratitude, refusal, hydraulic reversal, substitution, and fragmentation; I infer a causal arc in which misrecognized ownership dissolves beneficent coherence. The live alternative is a narrower warning about ingratitude that does not define the opening praise.

changed_reading.before: Praise follows from God's abstract ownership of a fertile earth.
changed_reading.after: Praise is the fitting return by which apportioned abundance remains legible as gift; refusal exposes human control and cohesion as reversible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The middle disputation decomposes supposed delegated power into ownership, fractional share, backing, and intercession, then denies each form of autonomy before a final gathering and judgment. The opening له ما becomes an exclusion of every secondary title to cosmic control, while الحكيم becomes the authority that separates claims by truth.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one anchors the focus allocation that competing devotional claims attempt to divide.
Judgment between parties supplies the focus attribute enacted when rival claims are finally separated.
Possession with power of disposal supplies the strongest delegated claim and is denied even at particle scale.
The minute dispersed particle supplies the lower bound below which no independent ownership remains.
Participation in a shared holding supplies a weaker title that is also denied.
A strengthening back or helper supplies the external-support model denied after ownership and share.
A supporter joining another supplies mediated efficacy, retained only under authorization.
Permission supplies the governing condition that prevents mediation from becoming autonomous power.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the forum in which competing claims become jointly answerable.
Opening a closure by judicial decision supplies the truthful separation of those claims.

structural_cues: 34:22 serially denies ownership, share, and backing in the same heavens-and-earth pair as 34:1.
34:23 makes even mediation permission-dependent, and 34:26 gathers the parties for truth-based adjudication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a descending ladder of possible secondary powers and a later judicial opening; I infer that this ladder analytically unfolds له ما. Alternatively, the passage only refutes particular cultic claims without specifying the semantics of the opening.

changed_reading.before: All things belong to God in a broad affirmative sense.
changed_reading.after: All things belong to God in a polemically exact sense: no rival owns, shares, backs, or mediates except within his permission and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The affluent mistake increased wealth and offspring for immunity and proximity, but provision is alternately spread and constricted, proximity is assigned by faithful action, and expenditure is followed by divine replacement. Under له ما, human possession becomes entrusted circulation rather than a stable measure of worth; praise remains due across changing allotments and final evaluation.

activation_trace.role: The later order anchors the evaluative horizon that overturns status inferred from present holdings.
Expansive luxury that releases its possessor from restraint supplies the social posture that mistakes gift for immunity.
Numerical increase supplies the comparative evidence the affluent invoke for superior standing.
Accumulated wealth supplies the apparent possession treated as proof of security.
Descendant offspring add inherited continuity to the claim of present security.
Expansion and increase supply one reversible mode of provision rather than a fixed verdict of favor.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the opposite mode governed by the same provider.
Privileged nearness supplies the status that wealth and offspring explicitly fail to produce.
Wealth going out in expenditure supplies the relinquishment that tests whether possession is treated as entrusted flow.
A condition or resource returning after disappearance supplies divine replacement after expenditure.

structural_cues: 34:34-35 links luxury and numerical abundance to rejection and a claim of immunity.
34:36-39 repeats expansion and constriction, denies that holdings create nearness, and closes with expenditure followed by replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boast, reversible allotment, denied proximity, expenditure, and replacement; I infer that ownership under 34:1 is fiduciary circulation rather than human status. The alternative is that these verses regulate attitudes to wealth without changing the opening's cosmic claim.

changed_reading.before: له ما includes wealth and children among the things God ultimately owns.
changed_reading.after: Present holdings are movable allotments, not verdicts of nearness; their praiseworthy use is release into a provision cycle whose value is settled later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly contrasts tested access to hidden reality with projected claims. Solomon's concealed death becomes known only through material decay; concealed regret later surfaces; God casts truth as knower of hidden things, while opponents cast speech at the hidden from a distant place and end in agitated doubt. الخبير is therefore an epistemic discriminator, not merely an omniscience formula.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge of an affair's interior anchors the distinction between intimate disclosure and remote projection.
Consumption and material decay supply the observable process that discloses a previously hidden death.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the capacity falsely presumed of the jinn and negated by the collapse.
What is screened from sight supplies the inaccessible object exposed by the failed knowledge claim.
Concealment in the interior supplies a human affective state that becomes visible when consequences arrive.
Forceful casting supplies truth's directed arrival from the one who knows hidden things.
The screened realm supplies the domain explicitly known by the source of that truthful casting.
Throwing words or accusations supplies the rival act of projecting claims without secure access.
Distance from proximity supplies the epistemic gap that makes the human casting conjectural.
Agitated doubt supplies the terminal inward condition produced by reliance on distant projection.

structural_cues: 34:14 makes a hidden-state claim fail when a small material process reveals what agents did not know.
34:48 and 34:53 repeat قذف with opposed agents and objects: truth from the knower of hidden things versus claims at the hidden from afar.
The final ayah names the inward state as destabilizing doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, material disclosure, repeated casting, hiddenness, distance, and doubt; I infer a deliberate contrast between warranted inward knowledge and speculative projection. A live alternative is that the two castings are rhetorically parallel but not an exposition of الخبير.

changed_reading.before: الخبير means generally that God knows everything he owns.
changed_reading.after: الخبير marks reliable access to interiors: divine truth proceeds from nearness to the hidden, while rival claims are throws from epistemic distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement removes reversibility: falsehood can neither initiate nor repeat, escape becomes impossible, belated belief cannot reach its object from afar, and a barrier is placed between agents and desire. This activates في الآخرة as the order in which wise judgment closes deferred alternatives and leaves the praiseworthy truth uncontested.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time anchors the focus horizon in which opportunities no longer remain indefinitely open.
The praiseworthy final limit supplies the evaluative endpoint of the closing sequence.
Beginning paired with return supplies the two generative capacities explicitly denied to falsehood.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the powerless term whose generative capacities have ended.
Return after departure supplies the second chance or recurrence that falsehood cannot perform.
Failure of escape or attainment supplies the closure of flight when seizure arrives.
Grasping and capture supply the enforcement that makes the closure effective.
The interrogative 'from where/how' supplies the impossibility of a newly claimed access.
Reaching by extension supplies the desired retrieval that distance now prevents.
A separator placed between two sides supplies the final barrier between agents and what they desire.

structural_cues: 34:49 denies both initiation and return to falsehood.
34:51-52 pairs near capture with impossible reaching from afar.
34:54 ends with a barrier between desire and its object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed beginning, failed return, capture, failed reaching, and separation; I infer that these are the mechanics of the later order in which praise reaches its settled object. Alternatively, the finale describes punishment without directly defining praise in the hereafter.

changed_reading.before: Praise continues into a later time much as it exists now.
changed_reading.after: Praise belongs to the later order because truth is then settled: false alternatives cannot restart, escape, retrieve, or cross back to desire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant وسم mapping inside سماوات and the concrete agricultural branch of خبير. It remains anchored in three focus words and is reinforced by provision-as-rain and Saba's managed water; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, never as a replacement lexical translation of السماوات or الخبير.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence السماوات...الأرض...الخبير can be cross-read through a rain-mark, productive-soil, and cultivator branch chain.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies an inscriptive relation between the upper domain and the ground.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving substrate on which the upper mark becomes growth.
Cultivating and repairing earth for a known share supplies the skilled tending function attached analogically to الخبير.
Rain descending as provision supplies the context bridge from sky-marking to edible yield.
Flowing floodwater supplies the same upper-to-earth transfer when it exceeds beneficent measure.
An embankment that contains floodwater supplies the cultivated system whose failed containment reverses fertility.

changed_reading.before: The heavens and earth are two owned cosmic locations known by the All-Aware.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper realm writes life-giving marks onto receptive earth, while the expert owner tends the conditions by which those marks become provision or, when measure reverses, flood.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the concrete bridle branch of حكم into divine governance. The focus anchor is exact and the following metal, measure, wind, permission, and deviation sequence supports a restraint mechanism; downstream prose should qualify it as a governing analogy rather than gloss الحكيم as 'bridler.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus epithet الحكيم can be materially activated by its bridle image when the surah immediately stages hard metal, wind, and workers brought under measured command.

activation_trace.role: A bridle surrounding the jaws and preventing uncontrolled running supplies the concrete control image for الحكيم.
Softening against roughness supplies the first transformation of resistant force into governable material.
Hard, resistant iron supplies the force that is made tractable without being abolished.
Fitting material to a proper middle measure supplies calibrated restraint rather than mere suppression.
Piercing and linking rings supplies the bounded articulation by which hard parts become useful protection.
Wind and moving air supply a large mobile force placed into directed service.
Authorization supplies the rule boundary within which powerful workers act.
Deviation from straightness supplies the escape from governed measure that triggers consequence.

changed_reading.before: الحكيم denotes abstract wisdom in the owner of all things.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, الحكيم is the governor who harnesses hard and mobile forces, preserving their power while giving it measure, linkage, permission, and direction.

strongest_changes: Static cosmic possession became monitored circulation and exact accounting.
Generic awareness became intimate, warranted knowledge contrasted with conjecture cast from afar.
Affirmative ownership became a denial of every autonomous share, helper, mediator, and status claim.
Praise became enacted response through measured craft and gratitude, with refusal yielding reversal and fragmentation.
Praise in the later order became a settled endpoint where falsehood cannot restart and belated reach fails.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made the opening doxology operate across movement, craft, water systems, social power, wealth, and epistemic distance. Split focus branches also exposed two contained material analogies: sky as rain-marking, cultivated earth under an expert, and wisdom as bridle-like governance of force.
remaining_uncertainties: The craft sequence may exemplify gifts that merit praise without making praise itself a distributed material response.
The final closure clearly resonates with في الآخرة, but it may describe consequence rather than the intrinsic mechanics of later praise.
The agrarian and bridle outliers are branch-backed analogies, not secure lexical senses in the focus syntax.
